intro: Al'Aketh Assassins is a quest involving the elimination of a dangerous group of lethal killers. Adventurers aid a scout in neutralizing the threat, earning formal recognition that will be included in a report to Valanaar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.
If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers.
Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.
